title: Introduction
slide_intent: Use a distinct chapter opening to separate orientation from detailed rules, helping readers keep the kinds of guidance apart.
strategic_value: The repeated display style can make introduction feel part of one Burger King document.

practical_value: Use this divider to identify where introduction guidance begins without interpreting it as a standalone application rule.
